report.interpretation: One-sided open-interest contract equivalents converted to XRP units. Not USD notional, spot holdings, collateral, or cash deployed.

dropped_contract.evidence: CFTC current COT index lists 176LM2 XRP - Coinbase Derivatives in both futures-only and futures-and-options-combined dropped-from-reporting lists.
dropped_contract.weekly_change_fields: CFTC archive prints a dot (.) for Total Change and all 14 position-change cells. These are unavailable values, not zeros.

reason_for_drop.hypothesis: The prior report showed exactly 20 total traders; CFTC staff FAQ says a contract may disappear when reportable large traders fall below 20.
reason_for_drop.alternative: Other reporting-universe or classification changes cannot be excluded from the published evidence.

contract_listing.data_sharing: Coinbase Derivatives filing describes an information-sharing agreement with Coinbase, Inc. for spot-market data in regulatory inquiries.
contract_listing.caveat: A cash-settled futures reference to Coinbase spot does not establish Coinbase customer flows, XRP custody, physical delivery, or actual capital deployed.

xrp_equivalent_reconciliation.warning: The 46.28% four-contract-to-three-contract comparison is a reporting-universe discontinuity. The 282.46M XRP-equivalent last report for 176LM2 is missing from the current report, not evidence that those positions were closed. The comparable continuing-three subset fell 12.94%.

cftc_tff.category_interpretation: The category net values sum to zero as matched futures positions. TFF categories are based on predominant business purpose self-reported on Form 40; CFTC says it does not know the specific reasons for traders' positions. Do not equate categories with hedging/speculation or a market-wide directional signal.
